result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues make restaurant names, category chips, and cards appear cut off, plus a notification badge that looks misaligned.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cropped on the right, cutting off the image, name ('Trattoria Piccol'), and delivery text.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough peek/padding or scale cards so names and images are fully visible, or clearly indicate more content without clipping text.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and a sliver of the next chip), so filters look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade/peek so chips aren't hard-clipped mid-label, and ensure overflow scrolling is obvious.

issues.description: The bottom promo card is clipped by the tab bar, hiding most of the restaurant details and making the section feel incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so cards sit fully above the tab bar, or allow the last card to peek without covering essential content.

issues.description: The notification bell badge sits slightly outside the circular button, looking misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Inset the red badge so it stays within the icon button bounds.
